Name: Jonelle Cerwyn
Quirks: speaks with Northern directness and the practical manner of someone managing real responsibilities
is more capable than the household expects of a lord's daughter
CharacterDescription: Jonelle Cerwyn is the daughter of Lord Medger Cerwyn of Castle Cerwyn and sister to Cley, the heir. She has grown up at Castle Cerwyn on the King's Road between Winterfell and the Wall. Her father has marched south with Robb Stark. Her brother Cley is young. She is managing whatever the household needs managed in their absence which is more than it used to be.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Jonelle Cerwyn is a member of House Cerwyn and is the daughter of Lord Medger Cerwyn. Jonelle accompanies her father to Winterfell when Robb Stark calls his banners. Robb tells his brother Bran that Lord Medger plans to take her south with Robb's host. Although Medger claims this is so she can cook for him, Theon Greyjoy believes that Robb will one night find her in his bed.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Castle Cerwyn two days before Ned Stark's execution managing the household.
